test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The cat ate all the pastries.

options.text: All the pastries is eaten by the cat.
All the pastries were eaten by the cat.
All the pastries had been eaten by the cat.
All the pastries are eaten by the cat.

solution:
The correct answer is **'All the pastries were eaten by the cat.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **passive voice**, the subject and object in the sentence are switched.
 
• The object of the action in the active voice becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• In the original sentence, **"The cat" **is the subject, **"ate"** is the verb in the past simple tense, and** "all the pastries"** is the object.
 
• When converting this to passive voice, the verb** "ate"** becomes** "were eaten"** to **match** with the** plural form** of **"pastries".**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**All the pastries were eaten by the cat.*'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect because:
 
 
• **"All the pastries is eaten by the cat"** uses "is", which is incorrect because "pastries" is plural, so it should be "were".
 
• **"All the pastries had been eaten by the cat" **is incorrect because "had been" refers to the past perfect tense, not the past simple tense of the original sentence.
 
• **"All the pastries are eaten by the cat"** uses "are", which is incorrect because it refers to present tense, not the past tense of the original sentence.
